title: Portrait photograph of Chief Photographer Delbert Clement Newhouse, USN, Feb. 18, 1952
description: Black-and-white head-and-shoulders portrait of a U.S. Navy officer in a white-topped officer's cap and dark uniform with ribbons, attached to a Navy "Instructions for Submission of Photograph" form. Handwritten fields below identify "Delbert Clement Newhouse", rank "ChPhot", file no. 177283, and date photograph was taken "Feb. 18, 1952".
